name: ImageMagick (convert)
description: Image conversion, resizing, and format changes via ImageMagick's convert. Use for thumbnails, format conversion, and basic edits. Falls back to 'magick' on newer installs.

presets.name: Convert to PNG
presets.description: Convert any supported image to PNG

presets.name: Convert to JPG (quality 90)
presets.description: Convert any supported image to JPEG at quality 90

presets.name: Convert to WebP
presets.description: Convert to WebP (smaller files, good for web)

presets.name: Thumbnail (max 512px)
presets.description: Resize so the longest side is at most 512px (keeps aspect ratio)

presets.name: Resize (custom — pass WxH in args)
presets.description: Resize with a custom geometry, e.g. args = 800x600 or 50%
